text: Kicking off the payment migration. Architecture doc is CONF-PAY-001 on Confluence. Original target cutover was 2026-10-15.
Read it. PAY-101 (schema migration to PostgreSQL) is in progress on my side.
Risk assessment draft is up as CONF-PAY-003. It is restricted to the core payment team for now.
Blocker: the legacy and PostgreSQL schemas disagree on nullable columns. Filed PAY-102.
Could we run a dual-write phase to bridge the gap?
Dual-write doubles the rollback surface. I would rather do a one-way backfill, that is PAY-104.
Runbook updated to v4 with the new rollback steps: CONF-PAY-002.
Risk assessment is now v2 (CONF-PAY-003). Schema incompatibility is the top risk.
Authentication timeouts appeared during staging validation. Tracked as PAY-103.
That looks like validation latency on the legacy session service. Related to AUTH-201.
Confirmed - p99 of 4.2s on /validate. This blocks the cutover.
We can enable the new OAuth 2.1 validation path behind a flag and re-test.
Given PAY-102 and PAY-103, the revised cutover target is 2026-11-05. CONF-PAY-001 is updated to v6 and the Drive timeline GDRIVE-PAY-001 is revised.
Do I have access to the risk assessment? I can only open CONF-PAY-001.
CONF-PAY-002 and CONF-PAY-003 are restricted to the core payment team. I will share the relevant extract with you directly.
Opening this channel for the Q3 incident. Draft postmortem is CONF-SEC-001.
How did the escalation happen?
A stale service account still had cluster-admin in staging. Full write-up is issue SEC-004.
Remediation is tracked in SEC-005 (privileged access audit logging) and SEC-006 (contractor production access review).
Auth signing key rotation is scheduled as AUTH-202. Details stay in this channel.
Q4 planning draft is up: CONF-FIN-001. The forecast workbook is CONF-FIN-002.
The payment migration delay pushes roughly 40k of infrastructure spend from Q4 into Q1. I will flag it to leadership.
Employee Handbook 2026 (CONF-HR-001) and the Remote Work Policy (CONF-HR-002) were updated today.
Are these documents available to contractors?
They are published to all employees. Contractor guidance comes from your agency agreement.
Payment migration cutover moved to 2026-11-05 - details in #payment-migration.
AUTH-201 (OAuth 2.1 upgrade) starts next sprint.
We need a load test before rollout - filed AUTH-204.
AUTH-203 is done - legacy session tokens are deprecated, the fallback path is removed in November.
AUTH-202 signing key rotation completed this morning.
DP-301 kickoff: the analytics warehouse is also moving to PostgreSQL. Plan is CONF-ENG-002. This is the data platform workstream, separate from the payment migration.
Security awareness training enrollment is open. Policy: CONF-HR-003, tracking: SEC-007.
Sessions run weekly and the slides live at GDRIVE-HR-002.
Q3 business review deck is ready: GDRIVE-FIN-002. Summary page: CONF-FIN-003.
AUTH-205 done - the updated auth SDK documentation is published.
